## F-20260907-02: [rigorix-oss] Policy/claims conformance — engine types vs rigorix-sdk policy.json + claims.json v1

### Context
Companion to F-20260907-01 (same batch, rigorix-sdk `b23492e`). rigorix-sdk now carries `schemas/policy.json` v1 (sequence-policy rule model + root-config surface) and `schemas/claims.json` v1 (IdentityClaim/IdentityRef), both grounded in engine code. This issue proves the engine's serialized policy + claim surfaces conform and fixes drift — the precondition for enterprise policy-bundle export alignment (F-20260907-04) and the Execution API.

### Grounding (code is truth)
- `engine/src/sequence_policy/domain/rule.rs` — SequenceRule, StepPredicate, ParamPredicate, ParamMatchKind, RuleAction, HistoryPredicate (R7), `SequencePolicyConfig` + SafetyCaps in `domain/config.rs`
- `engine/src/sequence_policy/infrastructure/repository/toml_repository.rs` — how `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml` maps into `SequencePolicyConfig` (`[sequence_policy]` / `[[rules]]` shape)
- `engine/src/identity/domain/claim.rs` — IdentityClaim (all Options serialize as null — no skips) + IdentityRef + IdentitySource (snake_case)
- rigorix-sdk `schemas/policy.json` + `schemas/claims.json` v1 @ `b23492e`

### In scope
- Conformance tests serializing REAL config/claims through engine types → validate against the SDK schemas:
  - Load a real `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml` (use conference-demo's — public repo, has `[[rules]]` incl. an R7 `history` rule) → serialize the parsed `SequencePolicyConfig` → validate vs `policy.json`; assert fail_closed/rules semantics match the file
  - Serialize `IdentityClaim` (idp_token + local_principal + unverified variants, token_ref null + set) and `IdentityRef` → validate vs `claims.json`
- Fix any drift found (engine-side fixes preferred; schema changes = contract decisions → raise in rigorix-sdk with evidence, don't edit schemas here)
- Make the parsed-policy JSON serialization reachable where the Execution API / enterprise alignment will consume it (export surface — minimal: a serde-serializable path with tests; no new public API unless one already exists)
- CI: same SDK-schema fetch wiring as F-20260907-01

### Out of scope
- Editing rigorix-sdk schemas (contract decisions)
- Envelope conformance (F-20260907-01)
- Enterprise policy_engine bundle export / JWKS verification (F-20260907-04, enterprise repo)

### DoD
- [ ] Policy conformance test green (real TOML file → JSON → schema; incl. R7 history rule)
- [ ] Claims conformance test green (IdentityClaim variants + IdentityRef)
- [ ] Drift findings raised with evidence; no silent schema edits
- [ ] Findings/log.md entry on completion

### References
- rigorix-sdk `b23492e` · conference-demo `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml` (public) · ADR-012 identity attestation · milestone-1 contract-sync doc
title: F-20260907-02: [rigorix-oss] Policy/claims conformance — engine types vs rigorix-sdk policy.json + claims.json v1

## F-20260907-01: [rigorix-oss] Envelope-v2 conformance — engine output vs rigorix-sdk schemas + real signed fixtures

### Context
Contract-sync milestone 1 (sync-by-doing, rigorix-sdk `b23492e`). rigorix-sdk now carries the authoritative `schemas/envelope.json` **v1** — reconciled byte-for-byte with `engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs` — plus `rust/rigorix-verifier` (protocol-only HMAC + schema verifier, 8 tests green). This issue proves the engine's real output conforms and that an independent verifier reproduces the engine's HMAC exactly (strategy A: the HMAC trail checkable anywhere).

### Grounding (code is truth)
- `engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs` — AuditEnvelope v2 structs (23 fields; serde attributes matter for canonical bytes)
- `engine/src/audit/application/envelope_factory_impl.rs::compute_signature` — canonical form: SHA-256-HMAC over `serde_json::to_string(envelope with signature=None)`; signature field serializes as `null`, NOT omitted
- rigorix-sdk `schemas/envelope.json` v1 @ `b23492e` — schema + documented canonicalization contract
- rigorix-sdk `rust/rigorix-verifier` @ `b23492e` — frozen structs + `canonical_bytes`/`sign`/`verify_signature`/`validate_schema` (reads schemas via `RIGORIX_SDK_SCHEMAS` env or `../../schemas`)
- Known-risk reconciliation: `EventStatus` has no `rename_all` → serde emits `Success|Failure|Skipped|Cancelled`. Schema v1 asserts this. Any engine path emitting lowercase is drift — this issue proves which is true end-to-end.

### In scope
- Conformance test in rigorix-oss validating engine-produced envelopes against `schemas/envelope.json` v1: cover (a) minimal unsigned `evidence_degraded=false`, (b) HMAC-signed, (c) rich envelope with identity + approval_events + scope_violations + sequence_policy_findings + scoring_results + decision_context_ref (build via the factory/real execution flow; do NOT hand-roll JSON that bypasses engine serialization)
- **Independent-HMAC proof**: take an engine-signed envelope JSON (engine's own signature) → run rigorix-verifier `verify_signature` against it → must pass byte-exact (proves canonicalization parity engine ↔ verifier)
- Produce **real signed fixtures**: 3–5 envelopes from actual engine runs (fixed test HMAC key, e.g. `fixture-hmac-key-2026`) covering signed/rich/sequence-finding variants → commit to rigorix-sdk `schemas/fixtures/envelope/*.json` (+ `KEY` note in a README there; key is a test-only key)
- CI wiring: conformance job/test fetches rigorix-sdk schemas (checkout `arman-jalili/rigorix-sdk` with the workflow token — same-owner private is fine) or `RIGORIX_SDK_SCHEMAS` env; green on the PR branch and main
- Fix any drift surfaced (schema bug vs engine bug — decide with evidence; schema changes are contract decisions → flag for SDK repo, don't silently edit schemas in this repo)

### Out of scope
- Editing `schemas/*` in rigorix-sdk (contract changes = SDK decisions; raise via issue there)
- Non-envelope schemas (policy/claims → F-20260907-02)
- The verifier crate itself (SDK repo; use it, don't vendor a copy)

### Run / verify
```bash
# engine unit/integration path that builds envelopes, then:
# conformance test validates serialized output against the schema + verifier
cargo test --all-features --test <conformance>   # per repo layout
# fixture generation: fixed key env + existing envelope factory
```

### DoD
- [ ] Conformance test green on PR branch + main (signed + unsigned + rich variants)
- [ ] Engine-signed envelope verified byte-exact by rigorix-verifier in CI (independent HMAC proof)
- [ ] Real signed fixtures committed to rigorix-sdk `schemas/fixtures/envelope/` (PR there, referenced here)
- [ ] No schema edits in this repo; drift findings raised as issues with evidence
- [ ] Findings/log.md entry (per repo convention) on completion

### References
- rigorix-sdk `b23492e` (schemas v1 + verifier) · strategy freeze D-2 (A first) · GAP-M-12 additive semantics · contract-sync 2026-09-06 milestone 1
title: F-20260907-01: [rigorix-oss] Envelope-v2 conformance — engine output vs rigorix-sdk schemas + real signed fixtures
